thread:
ingrid: FYI customer (Vostok Analytics GmbH) just escalated — they need a reverse-charge invoice and our system rejected their EU VAT ID during validation. They attached a resale certificate.
mike: Can you paste the VAT ID and the exact error? I can check our VIES call logs.
sara: VAT ID is DE287394012. Error in billing console: \"VIES lookup returned NO_MATCH for DE287394012 (format OK)\". Customer insists their tax office issued a national exemption letter.
mike: Hm. VIES sometimes NO_MATCH if it's a local registration or recently activated. Pulling VIES request for request_id rq_0a9f... one sec. billing-bot: VIES_CALL | ts=2025-11-08T13:22:19Z | request_id=rq_0a9f7c | vat_id=DE287394012 | result=NO_MATCH | raw_response=\"no match\"
ingrid: Customer says they've been trading for 2 yrs and provided a scanned national tax certificate (PDF). They want the invoice updated for reverse charge and VAT zeroed.
luca: Policy: we can manually apply reverse-charge only if finance has valid evidence (national certificate or EU resale cert) and legal signs off. Upload ticket to finance with attachments.
sara: Repro steps for our record: 1) On Billing > Customers > Vostok (cust_904) click Verify VAT. 2) System performs VIES lookup (call_id rq_0a9f7c). 3) VIES returns NO_MATCH. 4) UI shows \"VAT ID invalid\" and prevents reverse-charge toggle.
mike: For engineering: logs show we sent country=DE and vat=DE287394012. Example request sent to VIES (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://vies.europa.eu/validate \
  -d '{\"countryCode\":\"DE\",\"vatNumber\":\"287394012\"}' \
  -H \"x-request-id:rq_0a9f7c\"
```
mike: VIES responded with HTTP 200 but payload result=false. No transient 5xx. So likely a national registration mismatch.
ingrid: Customer provided PDF (attached in ticket). Can finance accept that or do we need an additional national registry confirmation? @luca
luca: Finance: we need either (A) national tax authority confirmation (screencap of registry lookup), or (B) a signed reseller certificate with company stamp. The PDF looks like an internal letter. Ask customer to provide the national registry URL or a scanned certificate that explicitly states VAT registration number.
sara: Customer reply: \"we're listed on Hamburg tax office registry\" and pasted link https://hamburg-tax.example/companies/DE287394012 — link 404 for us (probably intranet). They also say their VAT was recently reissued under new format.
mike: If it's a reissue, VIES may not have caught up. Short-term workaround: finance can issue a provisional credit (manual adjustment) if customer signs a declaration confirming validity, but must be reversible if later VIES denies it.
-ingrid: Proposed action items: 1) Support to request national registry URL or govt-issued cert (ask for URL that is publicly reachable). 2) Finance to review attached PDF and decide on provisional manual reverse-charge credit. 3) Escalate to tax team if finance is unsure. 4) Engineering: add more debug metadata to VIES logs (countryHint, timestamp, full request/response) — low priority.
luca: I'll take point on finance review. @sara can you ask the customer for (a) public registry link, (b) signed declaration accepting post-issue adjustments, and (c) resend PDF with higher res scans? Use the template below.
sara: Sending now. Template: \"To complete the reverse-charge request we need: 1) public registry link or government-issued certificate showing VAT ID DE287394012; 2) signed declaration accepting adjustments if lookup later fails; 3) higher-resolution PDF of your national certificate.\"
billing-bot: TICKET_CREATED | id=SUP-4721 | assignee=finance | priority=high
ingrid: Customer already replied with a notarized statement but wants the invoice changed urgently for their P.O. deadline tomorrow. They asked if we can temporarily flag invoice as \"reverse charge pending evidence\" so their AP team can proceed.
luca: Finance: we can add a note and a pending flag in the invoice metadata, but cannot zero VAT without evidence. If customer needs an internal note for their PO, we can attach our pending review stamp.
mike: Engineering follow-up: I'll add trace id propagation to the billing flow so future VIES checks include invoice_id and user_ip. Low risk change; will schedule for next sprint.
sara: Closing loop: I've asked customer for the three items and attached the finance ticket. I'll update when they reply. :thumbsup:
